summary: Retry transient agent environment capture timeouts before failing a launch

replay.detail: Retained objective evidence and replay behavior are unchanged.

schema.detail: No persistent schema or retained metadata changes.

rules.detail: Before entering the runtime backend, agent login-shell environment capture timeouts allow three total attempts. Existing scheduler deadlines provide deterministic two-second and four-second backoffs. A stable warning diagnostic is deduplicated while retrying and resolved after a successful start. Exhausted attempts report an explicit timeout failure; other errors remain terminal.

compatibility.detail: No claim fields, wire formats, client interfaces or store versions change. A timeout is not cached, so the next attempt actually captures the environment again. Launch ownership and declaration guards remain in force for every attempt.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond the normal daemon upgrade.

recovery.detail: Retries retain the existing guarded start operation and never repeat a backend launch. A daemon restart retains the existing interrupted-worker recovery behavior. Reverting requires no data migration.
